description: This Java class 'WebDavUtil' provides utility methods for handling WebDAV-related functionality, including date formatting, XML document parsing from HTTP requests, and extracting user credentials from HTTP requests with support for Basic Authentication. It is part of the org.apache.ofbiz.webapp.webdav package and interacts with the OFBiz framework's utility classes.

classes.name: WebDavUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for WebDAV operations such as date formatting, XML document extraction from requests, and user credential parsing.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on the specified format, using GMT timezone.

methods.name: getDocumentFromRequest
methods.description: Parses and returns an XML Document from the InputStream of an HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts user credentials (username and password) from an HttpServletRequest either via request parameters or Basic HTTP Authentication header.

methods.name: getRFC1123DateFormat
methods.description: Returns the RFC1123 date format string used for HTTP date headers.
